queries.g2_checkpoint: (TITLE:"G2/M" OR TITLE:"G2 checkpoint" OR TITLE:"cell cycle checkpoint") AND (ABSTRACT:CHK1 OR ABSTRACT:WEE1 OR ABSTRACT:ATR) AND OPEN_ACCESS:y NOT (radiosensiti* OR radiosensitiz* OR clonogenic) NOT (TITLE:Retracted OR TITLE:Correction OR TITLE:Erratum OR TITLE:Retraction)
queries.atm_atr_signalling: TITLE:(ATM OR ATR) AND ABSTRACT:"DNA damage response" AND OPEN_ACCESS:y NOT (radiosensiti* OR radiosensitiz* OR clonogenic) NOT (TITLE:Retracted OR TITLE:Correction OR TITLE:Erratum OR TITLE:Retraction)
queries.p53_mdm2_wip1: TITLE:(p53 AND (MDM2 OR WIP1 OR p21)) AND OPEN_ACCESS:y NOT (radiosensiti* OR radiosensitiz* OR clonogenic) NOT (TITLE:Retracted OR TITLE:Correction OR TITLE:Erratum OR TITLE:Retraction)
queries.dna_pk: TITLE:("DNA-PK" OR "DNA-PKcs") AND ABSTRACT:"DNA damage" AND OPEN_ACCESS:y NOT (radiosensiti* OR radiosensitiz* OR clonogenic) NOT (TITLE:Retracted OR TITLE:Correction OR TITLE:Erratum OR TITLE:Retraction)
queries.senescence_mtor: TITLE:senescence AND ABSTRACT:(p53 AND mTOR) AND ABSTRACT:"DNA damage" AND OPEN_ACCESS:y NOT (radiosensiti* OR radiosensitiz* OR clonogenic) NOT (TITLE:Retracted OR TITLE:Correction OR TITLE:Erratum OR TITLE:Retraction)
queries.apoptosis_autophagy: TITLE:(apoptosis OR autophagy) AND ABSTRACT:(p53 AND "DNA damage") AND OPEN_ACCESS:y NOT (radiosensiti* OR radiosensitiz* OR clonogenic) NOT (TITLE:Retracted OR TITLE:Correction OR TITLE:Erratum OR TITLE:Retraction)
